description: This file defines the `ExecHostRequestEvaluator` containing static methods for validating and evaluating execution requests related to system commands, including associated data structures and decision enums.

methods.name: validateRequest
methods.description: Validates an `ExecHostRequest` by cleansing the command and ensuring it is not empty, then resolves it through a validator to produce a `Result` with either a validated request or an error.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Evaluates an execution request within a specific security context and based on an optional approval decision, returning a policy decision such as allow, deny, or require prompt.
